column1: # For every criterion whose CITED witness does not discharge the
# frozen predicate, the WHOLE predecessor evidence tree is searched
# for a DIFFERENT artifact that DOES carry the frozen subject.
# A candidate qualifies only if it EXISTS at the predecessor, is a
# DIFFERENT path, carries a MAJORITY of the frozen predicate
# distinctive subject tokens, AND was committed by the phase the
# The predecessor evidence is EXTRACTED ONCE from the committed
# blobs into a scratch tree; the search is local. NO new
# measurement is manufactured and NO historical file is edited.
